title: Onion Salad (Laccha Pyaz)
description: Thinly sliced onion rings tossed with lemon juice, chaat masala and a touch of chilli powder — the classic side at any kebab or dhaba meal.
steps: Soak the sliced onion rings in cold water for 10 minutes to mellow their sharpness, then drain well.
Transfer to a serving bowl and squeeze over the lemon juice.
Sprinkle with chaat masala, red chilli powder and salt.
Toss well and garnish with coriander leaves. Serve immediately for the best crunch.
